# Canonical-fixture generator parameters
#
# Used by `_generate.py` (committed alongside) to produce
# `in_10.json` .. `in_49.json` and `out_00.json` .. `out_49.json`.
# Stdlib `random` only — no hypothesis dep — so output is stable
# across Python versions and library upgrades.
#
# Generator parameters:
#   - random.Random seed: 20260508
#   - max_depth: 3 (recursion budget per value)
#   - max_branch: 4 (max children per list/dict)
#   - leaf kinds: null | bool | int (-2**31..2**31) | float (uniform -1e6..1e6) | str
#   - alphabet: ASCII letters + digits + " _-éàü" (small unicode sample)
#   - count: 40 fixtures (NN = 10..49)
#
# The companion property test (`test_canonical.py`) re-uses this seed
# in its hypothesis-style randomized test. Each `out_NN.json` is the
# byte-exact output of `canonicalize(load(in_NN.json))` computed by
# `scripts/_canonical.py`.
#
# Re-running `_generate.py` with the same seed MUST produce
# byte-identical fixtures. Bump the seed only if the strategy itself
# changes; never to "fix" a broken canonicalizer.
seed: 20260508
